Rank 26 - Health

Dental Clinic Appointment and Follow-Up

Dental clinics need serial, treatment plan, follow-up date, payment due, and reminder messages.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 10,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 700Recommended monthly charge

BDT 700/month is practical because follow-up retention can pay for the software.

6.8Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 10,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 700Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 9,200,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Public map datasets show more than 6,000 dental clinics. Target small clinics needing appointments and treatment follow-up.

Patients forget follow-up and payment schedules; clinic assistants track everything manually.

Patients return on time and the clinic sees treatment dues clearly.

Validation signals

  • Dental clinic count is visible.
  • Follow-up is recurring.
  • Assistants already manage serials.
  • Patient reminders have clear value.

MVP modules

  • Appointment
  • Patient profile
  • Treatment note
  • Follow-up reminder
  • Payment due
  • Doctor schedule
  • Daily report

Do not build first

  • Do not build diagnosis tools.
  • Do not store images first.
  • Do not claim medical compliance.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Pilot with 5 clinics.
  • Use follow-up reminders.
  • Add payment due.
  • Add treatment templates later.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Health data sensitivity.
  • Custom treatment types.
  • Assistant workflow.
Mitigations
  • Minimal data.
  • Flexible treatment labels.
  • Fast assistant UI.
